owner_request: Complex quarry requires detail; V1 held as ultra rough
details: Connected hewn bedrock and stepped benches with actual wedge kerfs
Irregular chipped floor, mineral fractures and seated splitting wedges
Split bored bearing blocks, bronze bushes, studs, washers and nuts
Bolted timber cheek straps, heel anchors and diagonal bracing
Spindle bores, laid rope coil and fixed cable guide
Cleaved cargo, bucket strap rivets and handle pins
Individual brick courses and fitted arch, grate, ash pan and mounted door
Seated riveted heat jacket, dished crown, relief and mechanical gauge
Bored drive cylinder, sealed heads, guide stops and their supports
Bonded brick stock, lashed laid tools and receiving skid
